column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan rule config.
# Philosophy matches security/triage/triage.py: don't fail the build on every
# informational finding. FAIL is reserved for issues with a clear, exploitable
# security impact; everything else is WARN (annotated on the PR, non-blocking)
# or IGNORE (known noise for this app's architecture).

column3: X-Content-Type-Options header missing - low severity, track but don't block
Strict-Transport-Security header missing - forces plaintext downgrade possible
Private IP disclosure - expected in ephemeral CI test environment
Re-examine Cache-control directives - not applicable to API-only sample app
